name: How To Live
overview: Scripture guides believers in how to live by emphasizing attentive obedience to God's words, as Proverbs urges us to incline our ears to divine instruction. The Word of God is described in Hebrews as living and powerful, able to penetrate deeply into our hearts and discern our innermost thoughts and intentions. Living rightly, therefore, involves submitting fully to God and resisting the devil, assured that such resistance will cause him to flee, as James instructs.
